name: Cheesy Cauliflower Mac and Cheese with Smoked Sausage
fit_evidence: Published 588 cal / 10g carbs / 26g protein per serving clears 400-650 cal and <=35g carb on its own numbers (588 sits near the ceiling - recompute could drift over 650). Qualifies on the gate; rejected on duplication, not fitness.
reason: Same dinner as pool-mate pork-sausage-cauliflower-cheese-bake on all four identity axes - main protein (pork sausage), flavor family (cheese sauce), base (cauliflower cut/floret in place of starch), method (oven bake). The differences (cheddar/monterey-jack + Cajun + smoked-sausage links vs Gruyere/cream-cheese + fresh British sausage) are seasoning/cheese swaps, not a different plate. Kept the British version for cuisine spread and lower carbs; this American mac-style take is the pool-dupe loser.
catalog_evidence: No exact catalog duplicate in the pork digest either; cheesy-smoked-sausage-rice-skillet is a rice skillet, different base. This is a within-batch (pool) dupe, not a catalog dupe.
borderline_note: Borderline: British cauliflower-cheese vs American cauliflower-mac-and-cheese could be argued a distinct comfort-food take. If the decider wants the American-skew comfort version over the British one, this is the candidate to swap in - but the catalog should not ship BOTH.
cross_protein_collisions: Belongs to the same sausage-and-cauliflower-cheese-bake cluster flagged on the KEEP verdict; any smoked-turkey-sausage cauliflower-mac in another pool would also be this dish.
